fixes: Reject unrecognized test-server routes and malformed reports; stop reflecting request paths into HTML.
Escape generated dialog test literals, including HTML delimiters and Unicode line separators.
Replace the electron-is-dev dependency with equivalent local packaged/development detection, preserving ELECTRON_IS_DEV overrides.
Update build-only minimatch/glob to patched versions and remove their audit exceptions.
Retry unowned native shortcuts on window focus after another process releases them, without stealing active shortcuts.

validation.linuxPackages: AppImage, DEB, RPM and tar.gz built and payload-verified for x64, ARM64 and ARMv7. Native x64/ARM64 startup, recording, clean dependency and removal checks passed in CI; ARMv7 was cross-built and statically verified.
validation.native: 45 window scenarios, 14 dialog checks and 20 closed-window retention cycles passed. Native two-process shortcut recovery fails on published 2.23.5 and passes with the fix.

bareElectronRecordingControl.conclusion: The roughly 200 ms startup audio delay also occurs without EleCap code; do not introduce speculative app-level audio retiming.

crossPlatformCI.windows: Both x64 runtime variants and ARM64 packages verified, Authenticode signatures/timestamps passed, and x64 installer replacement/rollback passed.
crossPlatformCI.macos: Universal x86_64/ARM64 build, signatures, notarization, package contents and security fuses verified.
